description: User-approved 120-call single-profile probe, hard cap USD 0.10. comments.author: home
comments.text: Intent recorded before code. Feature: bounded public-profile proxy probe. Scenario: offline dry run produces exactly 120 randomized requests with fixed qualifications, six variants and two isolated questions. Scenario: recording refuses a payload exceeding the conservative input allowance or a budget below the reserved maximum, disables retries, pins jev-1.13.0 and preserves each response before analysis. Scenario: replay derives the same summary without a network call. User approved USD 0.10 in chat on 2026-09-28. No downstream real-world consequence or population claim.
